name: rtdb-modular-query-constraint-conflicts
description: RTDB modular synchronous query() constraint-conflict validation across duplicate orderBy*, duplicate limits, duplicate start/end bounds, equalTo() combinations, and chained query() calls.

orderByChildThenOrderByKey.errorMessage: orderByKey: You can't combine multiple orderBy calls.

orderByKeyThenOrderByValue.errorMessage: orderByValue: You can't combine multiple orderBy calls.

orderByValueThenOrderByPriority.errorMessage: orderByPriority: You can't combine multiple orderBy calls.

limitFirstThenLimitLast.errorMessage: limitToLast: Limit was already set (by another call to limitToFirst or limitToLast).

limitFirstThenLimitFirst.errorMessage: limitToFirst: Limit was already set (by another call to limitToFirst or limitToLast).

startAtThenStartAfter.errorMessage: startAfter: Starting point was already set (by another call to startAt, startAfter, or equalTo).

startAtThenEqualTo.errorMessage: equalTo: Starting point was already set (by another call to startAt/startAfter or equalTo).

startAtThenStartAt.errorMessage: startAt: Starting point was already set (by another call to startAt, startBefore or equalTo).

endAtThenEndBefore.errorMessage: endBefore: Starting point was already set (by another call to endAt, endBefore or equalTo).

equalToThenEndAt.errorMessage: endAt: Starting point was already set (by another call to endAt, endBefore or equalTo).

endAtThenEndAt.errorMessage: endAt: Starting point was already set (by another call to endAt, endBefore or equalTo).

chainedDuplicateOrderBy.errorMessage: orderByChild: You can't combine multiple orderBy calls.

chainedDuplicateLimit.errorMessage: limitToLast: Limit was already set (by another call to limitToFirst or limitToLast).
